label: Baseline MVP
notes: Deliberately minimal while the shape of the game is being played: cards are worth 0 or 1, a troop is strength 1 and costs 1 supply, every town supplies 2. Hand size 3 rather than 5 — a big hand lets the rebels rush the Empire's starting city before it can stand anything up, and placing five cards a turn is a chore. It makes the game 20 turns. Everlan starts with 3 troops rather than 2: the Empire was losing its capital to an early rush before it could stand anything up. Not tuned — the graded cards and the heterogeneous map are in the other scenarios and in the git history when it is time to put them back.
